title: Learn

words.note: 較正式，強調透過閱讀、教學、經驗或訓練而獲得知識。

exercises.original: Students learn through reading, discussion, and practice.
exercises.zh: 本題需判斷 learn 在這裡是知識獲得、技能掌握、學習過程、自然習得、事實得知，還是深層吸收。
exercises.upgrade: acquire knowledge · 獲取知識；學習知識

— study = 有意識地閱讀、練習或修讀；強調過程。 一般用於不同的學習階段、結果或資訊類型；本句更需要 Acquire knowledge 的語義。

— master = 把技能／知識掌握到高水平。 一般用於不同的學習階段、結果或資訊類型；本句更需要 Acquire knowledge 的語義。
— memorise = 記住／背熟，不保證理解。 一般用於不同的學習階段、結果或資訊類型；本句更需要 Acquire knowledge 的語義。

falseSynonyms.zh: 學習過程不等於已經學會
falseSynonyms.point: You can study French for years without fully learning it.
A student may memorise a rule without learning how to use it.
I know the answer because I learned it yesterday.

falseSynonyms.zh: 理解只是學習結果的一部分
falseSynonyms.point: You may learn a fact before fully understanding its significance.
The teacher teaches; the student learns.

falseSynonyms.zh: 練習是學習方法，不等於學會
falseSynonyms.point: You practise a skill in order to learn or master it.
You can find out the train time, but not normally 'find out' how to play the piano.

falseSynonyms.zh: 比普通 learn 強很多
falseSynonyms.point: You can learn basic chess without mastering chess.
